ce_bugs.text: packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:96 — prisma.credential.update` is called but `prisma` is never imported in this file, causing a ReferenceError on every token refresh (getClient runs in the constructor).

packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:9 — The sync-endpoint fetch never checks `response.ok`/status before returning the Response to callers, so an error page, 500, or empty body from CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is passed through as if it were a valid token response, deferring/obscuring failure detection to inconsistent per-provider parsing code.

mrv_findings.text: apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:20-27,62-88 — IDOR: single global shared secret with no per-user/tenant scoping lets anyone holding CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET create/overwrite OAuth credentials for ANY userId in the instance, full credential-takeover primitive (confidence 100, P0).

apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:20-23 — Non-constant-time `!==` comparison of webhook secret header enables timing-based brute force of the one static secret gating the whole endpoint (confidence 85, P1).
apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts — No rate limiting/backoff on webhook endpoint, compounding the timing leak and IDOR blast radius (confidence 75, P1).

apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:60 — `symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || "")` silently falls back to empty-string key instead of failing closed when env var unset, yielding a predictable derived key (confidence 70, P2).
apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:79,88 — Distinct success/404 messages leak userId existence and credential create-vs-update state to any secret holder (confidence 60, P3).

apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:19-24 — Trust-boundary design flaw: single static secret with no per-user scoping, no audit trail, effectively a "become anyone's OAuth app" primitive (confidence 90, P0).

apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:53-61 — `prisma.credential.findFirst({userId, appId})` assumes one credential per app per user (no unique constraint enforced); a user with two accounts of the same app type gets an arbitrary row silently clobbered (confidence 60, P1).

packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:5-21 — Polymorphic return type: raw fetch Response in sync mode vs. arbitrary refreshFunction() result otherwise; callers must know which mode is active or misread the shape (confidence 90, P1) — root cause of the two deterministic api-contract findings above.

packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:6-9 — `[z.string().toString()]` computed keys evaluate to fixed literal "ZodString", not a dynamic/catch-all matcher; the "minimum" schema silently fails to validate an expiry field exists as documented (confidence 90, P1).

packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:75-102 — Unconditional token refresh + prisma write inserted on every connection-get call with no expiry gate, adding per-request network/DB overhead and risking invalidating valid tokens / hitting Salesforce refresh rate limits (confidence 85, P1).

packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/createOAuthAppCredential.ts:31-46 — Team-credential branch checks membership only (no `throwIfNotHaveAdminAccessToTeam` call), so any accepted (non-admin) team member can create app credentials for the team (confidence 65, P2).
packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:89 — `response.statusText !== "OK"` is an unreliable success check vs. `response.ok`/status code (confidence 60, P3).
apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:1-93 — No test file exists for the new webhook endpoint's auth/not-found/create/update paths (confidence 90, P1).

packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:72-99 — New refresh logic bypasses `refreshOAuthTokens()`/CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT entirely, so Salesforce never participates in credential sync unlike every other provider wired in this diff (confidence 85, P1).

packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:7-10 — `minimumTokenResponseSchema`'s computed keys are a no-op bug, not enforcing numeric-expiry validation as intended (confidence 85, P1) — corroborates architecture/data-migration findings.

packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/createOAuthAppCredential.ts:24-36 — Team branch trusts appData.type/appId from caller and skips admin-role check present in the non-team branch, letting regular team members add integrations (confidence 60, P2).

apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:93-95 — No try/catch around `.parse(req.body)`, `symmetricDecrypt`, or `JSON.parse`; malformed input yields uncaught 500s instead of clean 400s (confidence 75, P2).
apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts — No `req.method` check; non-POST verbs fall through to body parsing and likely 500 instead of 405 (confidence 55, P3).

packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:5 — Sync gated on `userId` truthiness only; team-owned credentials (userId null, teamId set) never sync with parent app, an unhandled edge case (confidence 55, P3).

apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:93-127 — Webhook writes fully unvalidated decrypted JSON straight into `credential.key` with no schema check against the app's expected shape, risking silent corruption of an existing working credential (confidence 85, P1).

packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:94-98 — Refresh path overwrites entire `key` JSON with only `salesforceTokenSchema` fields + refresh_token, silently dropping any other previously-stored fields unlike Office365's spread-merge pattern (confidence 60, P2).

packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts:177-201 — When sync mode is enabled, `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a raw Response but caller reads `.expiresIn`/`.accessToken` directly without `.json()`, producing `NaN` expiry and `setAccessToken(undefined)` (confidence 90, P1).

packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:96-98 — Dead code: `parseRefreshTokenResponse` already throws on parse failure, so the `!accessTokenParsed.success` reject branch is unreachable (confidence 80, P3).
packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/api/add.ts:17 — Hardcodes `/api/integrations/zoho-bigin/callback` instead of using `appConfig.slug` like the rest of the file (confidence 70, P3).

packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:75-98 — Entirely new eager token-refresh feature added with no prior refresh logic existing, going beyond "credential sync" task scope and inconsistent with other providers (confidence 80, P1).
packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/api/add.ts:17 — Unrelated hardcoding regression bundled into the credential-sync task diff (confidence 75, P2).
docs/tasks/task-001.md — Task spec provides no acceptance criteria, making it impossible to bound scope-creep such as the Salesforce refresh addition (confidence 75, P2).
